details: Idea is to have a photo frame type pedestal that can be mounted to the walls in any of your chat world. If a world is hosted by a group. We can have a specific section to upload a group rules sticker, basically. That would automatically be posted in those worlds in those pedestals. So for instance if I decided I wanted to create a world instance. All I would have to do is open it up and the same way how we can enable and disable drones and Sticker pedestals and everything else. It would be in that list where to say. Would you like to post the rules in the world? You click yes to that. Then it will automatically post your rule sticker that you uploaded to VRchat. into those pedestals in the world so that way in the event that the instance is not moderated at that time. People know what the rules are and two how to contact somebody if somebody is breaking those rules. this would be a great way to assist for moderating for age Gates and things like that. There's a lot of people that just simply don't know that the groups they're joining have rules and to make it enjoyable for everybody. If you join a Lobby, it'd be nice to know right away that those rules are there rather than me having to post a rule sticker on a wall. In a world that maybe I don't want to have stickers enabled.
title: group rules auto post Pedestal world asset
